title: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom over a dimmed page, on a native modal dialog: backdrop, focus trap and Escape come with it. A bottom sheet has a grab handle and swipe-to-close on touch. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

props.name: persistent
props.description: The backdrop does not close it.

props.name: wide
props.description: A wider panel (up to 70% of the viewport).

props.name: controlled
props.description: The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers.

props.name: docked
props.description: A non-modal inspector: it sits inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, has no backdrop and no focus trap, and the page behind stays usable. Escape still asks to close.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Actions strip under the header (Save, Cancel).

events.name: pk-close
events.description: escape, backdrop, close button, swipe or method.

parts.name: handle
parts.description: Grab handle of a bottom sheet

a11y: A native modal dialog with an accessible name; focus returns to the opener on close; Escape and the backdrop close it (set persistent to keep the backdrop inert).
mobile: Left and right drawers are at most 90vw wide; the bottom sheet takes at most 85% of the height; swipe toward the edge it came from to close.
